projects.title: Gen AI MLT Partner Bot
projects.description: Gathers 10-Q and 10-K data for all publicly traded MLT Partners, then builds a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhanced bot to ask deep questions only found within those company filings.

projects.title: Mobile Medical Application
projects.description: The client wanted a platform where medical professionals can navigate and organize their information for their clients. The medical app is designed for user-friendly interaction by medical professionals. Therefore, the app was designed to be as interactive as possible by ensuring accessibility on two major platforms: Android and iOS. The team worked diligently throughout 3 months with the primary goal of providing security, user-friendly navigation, and a database for client information.
